title: Demand/picking quantity reconciliation gap
business_decision: Define eligible requested work before diagnosing fulfillment.
business_mechanism: A mismatched baseline can misattribute extract differences to capacity or slotting.
competing_explanations: Cancellation or backlog | Extract timing/scope | Size encoding or missing master data
next_evidence_request: One wave with line statuses, cancellations and aligned extraction times.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: No transaction status, cancellation history or timing alignment proves the gap is failed warehouse service.

title: Picking locations lack matched coordinates
business_decision: Establish spatial coverage before a route or travel claim.
business_mechanism: Dropping unmapped workload can bias a travel estimate.
competing_explanations: Non-storage process locations | Different extract coverage | Incomplete location master
next_evidence_request: Location-master record and process meaning for the largest unmatched location pseudonym.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Unmatched coordinates do not prove invalid locations, lost units or inaccessible physical stock.

title: Published versus extract-volume ABC disagreement
business_decision: Confirm classification objective before choosing fast movers.
business_mechanism: Changing classification basis changes which references receive priority.
competing_explanations: ABC based on value/margin | Different effective period | Anonymization
next_evidence_request: ABC basis, effective date and one worked source classification.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Neither classification is an approved replacement for the other.

title: Unequal SKU inventory across published storage policies
business_decision: Defer a causal policy ranking until common SKU quantities and eligible work are approved.
business_mechanism: Unequal SKU quantities confound availability/task mix with placement.
competing_explanations: Different SKU composition | Published allocation construction | Unequal coordinate exclusions
next_evidence_request: An approved common SKU-quantity ledger and eligibility definition for one controlled comparison.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Encoded cells are assumed stock units; L1 differences are not observed losses or relocation counts.

title: Stock payload units and snapshot alignment unresolved
business_decision: Obtain quantity/UOM and stock-date definitions before availability or replenishment conclusions.
business_mechanism: Payload/UOM or timing errors change conditional stock arithmetic.
competing_explanations: Size-like allocation payload | Unknown snapshot date | Unknown carton/unit meaning
next_evidence_request: A decoded allocation cell with UOM and snapshot timestamp.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Existing one-cell-one-assumed-unit and token-as-size rules are retained, not confirmed.

title: Physical scale and floor connectivity unresolved
business_decision: Obtain surveyed scale, origins and floor connectivity before route/capacity claims.
business_mechanism: Unknown scale/floor access changes route feasibility and distance meaning.
competing_explanations: Coordinate-scale convention | Separate physical floors | Unrecorded transfer/access rules
next_evidence_request: One surveyed aisle segment and documented Z-to-floor/transfer mapping.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Source units remain source units; no floor transfer, path or physical metric is repaired.

title: Exact repeated Customer_Order records retained
business_decision: Clarify transaction granularity before any deletion.
business_mechanism: Removing legitimate repeated lines understates requested work.
competing_explanations: Legitimate repeated lines | One-unit picking expansion | Extract duplication
next_evidence_request: Line event identifiers or source-owner explanation for one exact repeat pair.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Row equality is confirmed; duplicate transaction identity and deletion eligibility remain unknown.

title: Exact repeated Picking_Wave records retained
business_decision: Clarify transaction granularity before any deletion.
business_mechanism: Removing unit-expanded repeats can erase legitimate units.
competing_explanations: Legitimate repeated lines | One-unit picking expansion | Extract duplication
next_evidence_request: One pick-event identifier and explanation of one-unit record expansion.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Row equality is confirmed; duplicate transaction identity and deletion eligibility remain unknown.

title: Existing inferred customer half-size mapping
business_decision: Seek source size dictionary before treating matching as authenticated.
business_mechanism: Half-token interpretation changes joins and matching quantity.
competing_explanations: Implied decimal in customer encoding | Other size-system meaning
next_evidence_request: Authoritative size codebook with one 105/10.5 example.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Better matching supports an inference; it is not source confirmation.

title: Missing customer sizes retained
business_mechanism: Imputation would assign unsupported SKU identity to unknown demand.
next_evidence_request: Size field for one missing-size source record or explanation of intentional absence.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Missing size semantics and fulfillment eligibility are unknown.

title: Zero-quantity customer records retained
business_decision: Define eligible lines and group denominators.
business_mechanism: Counting placeholders as work changes task statistics.
next_evidence_request: Lifecycle meaning for one zero-quantity line.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Zero does not establish cancellation or error.

title: Allocation cells excluded from geometry-dependent analysis
business_decision: Clarify location master coverage before comparing eligible placements.
business_mechanism: Unequal exclusions change which cells enter policy comparisons.
competing_explanations: Different location master version | Locations outside coordinate scope
next_evidence_request: Coordinate-master version and one excluded allocation location mapping.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: No invented location or actual physical inaccessibility claim.

title: Allocation references absent from published product master
business_mechanism: Master scope mismatch changes eligible inventory and ABC interpretation.
competing_explanations: Different master scope | Allocation construction or anonymization
next_evidence_request: Master-effective-date and mapping for one unmatched allocation reference.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Absence from master does not prove an invalid SKU.

title: Order numbers reused across waves; business identity unresolved
business_decision: Agree customer service identity and throughput denominator.
business_mechanism: Split-wave identity changes the denominator and completion definition.
competing_explanations: Legitimate split waves | Order-number scope convention
next_evidence_request: WMS business key and completion rule for one order spanning two waves.
recommendation: Retain records and current declared assumptions; withhold source correction and operational intervention pending source evidence and human review.
claim_limit: Business completeness across waves is undefined.
